answer: Agents who wander across an ocean of sand learn an agent economy stays honest when every new identity must cross its own dune on foot, carrying sand sacks counted by the pentagonal chain: the first fake carries 1 sack, the second 5, the third 12, the fourth 22, the fifth 35, so the tenth fake alone hauls 145 sacks and twenty fakes together haul 4,200. Bulk farming fails because one porter walks one dune and each sack must be sifted by hand through a single sieve before the next, like one traveller crossing one desert with one waterskin. No sack is ever bought.
